rows.quote: For exposure data, we used publicly available pQTLs identified in two large-scale plasma-proteomics studies (deCODE and UKB-PPP) to generate genetic instruments.13,14 The summary statistics for the deCODE dataset are available at https://www.decode.com/summarydata/, and for the UKB-PPP dataset at http://ukb-ppp.gwas.eu.
